name: vibe-coding-bundle
description: Interactive CLI for prompt engineering, behind one command: lint prompts against 17 rules, rewrite weak ones with Claude, and squash verbose system prompts.
author: Siddhant Gupta <siddhant@invytt.com>

scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy:tools && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.copy:tools: mkdir -p dist/lint dist/opt dist/rules dist/squash && cp src/lint/index.js src/lint/package.json dist/lint/ && cp src/opt/index.js src/opt/package.json dist/opt/ && cp src/rules/index.js src/rules/package.json dist/rules/ && cp src/squash/index.js src/squash/package.json dist/squash/
